brand.name: MidGate
brand.personality: Secure, Premium, Modern, Trustworthy, Professional, Technical, Clean, Calm, Global
brand.logo_concept: A minimalistic geometric monogram 'M' intersecting a subtle gate or shield structure, indicating security and passage. Wordmark uses tracking-tight geometric sans.

theme.strategy: Clean enterprise SaaS. Stripe-level clarity mixed with Linear's technical precision. High contrast, low noise. Absolutely no hacker aesthetics or neon overdoses.

colors.notes: No red dominance (used only for destructive actions). Primary action is deep indigo. Avoid generic SaaS blue. Teal is explicitly forbidden in dashboards.

headings.notes: Used for landing page hero, dashboard section headers. Gives a crisp, modern, tech-forward vibe.

body.notes: Highly legible for data-heavy tables, analytics, and lists.

monospace.notes: Used for IP addresses, tokens, short links, and IDs.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous Spacing Philosophy. Wide margins, breathing room on marketing pages. Dense, intentional utility on dashboard.

marketing.grid: Bento Grid (Tetris Mode) - grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-8 to gap-12
marketing.hero_overlay: Max bg-black/40 (dark) or bg-white/30 (light). Do not kill images.

dashboard.grid: High Density Grid - grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4
dashboard.density: Data-table-first structure. Card-based widgets with grouped metrics. Use sharp edges or max 8px border-radius.

spacing_and_layout.shadows: Soft ambient shadow combined with 1px inner border. Use shadow-sm for cards to ground them.

components.strategy: Shadcn UI heavily customized to match the brand. Strip the default Vercel-look, inject enterprise feel.
components.buttons: Slightly rounded (rounded-md), crisp. Primary button is Indigo. Interaction states must have visible hover/focus ring.
components.inputs: Clean, 1px border. Focus ring should be primary indigo.
components.cards: Flat background, 1px border (border-border), crisp edges. No heavy glassmorphism.
components.tables: Dense, crisp lines, optional zebra striping, clear hover states on rows. Left-align data unless it's numeric (then right-align).
components.charts: Shadcn charts (Recharts) with brand colors. Accessible contrast.
components.navigation: Sticky nav with solid or crystal glass (backdrop-blur-xl bg-background/80). NEVER transparent.

visual_enhancers.motion: Minimalist. Micro-interactions for feedback. Hover lifts (-translate-y-1) for dashboard cards.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise on dark mode backgrounds to prevent flatness, or keep entirely clean and Swiss.
visual_enhancers.surfaces: Use Grid Borders (The Technical Look) for features sections. Expose the skeleton. border-collapse layouts.

media.icons: Phosphor Icons (@phosphor-icons/react) for duotone high-end look on marketing, solid/regular on dashboard.

images.description: Person typing on a laptop, professional setting.
Blue background with network lines and dots, for security/network representations.
Abstract organic layered network, for deep tech vibe.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install necessary packages: `yarn add @phosphor-icons/react framer-motion clsx tailwind-merge`
Configure Tailwind with the provided design tokens. Override Vercel/Shadcn defaults.
Use Phosphor Icons for all icons.
Create a solid workspace switcher in the dashboard.
Implement light and dark mode toggles.
Ensure all interactive elements have `data-testid` attributes.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) where appropriate, but NOT on medical/dashboard data.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Add transitions for specific properties.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. Do not add `.App { text-align: center; }`.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
